rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an act or treatment that humiliates someone or affronts their dignity.

example.english: Being scolded in front of so many people was a real indignity.
example.traditional: 佢當住咁多人鬧我，真係一種侮辱。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dong1 zyu6 gam3 do1 jan4 naau6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 jat1 zung2 mou5 juk6

rows.note: Use this for a more severe or formal sense of degradation and humiliation rather than an ordinary personal affront.

example.english: The prisoners of war endured a grave indignity.
example.traditional: 戰俘受到非人道對待，承受極大屈辱。
example.jyutping: zin3 fu1 sau6 dou3 fei1 jan4 dou6 deoi3 doi6 sing4 sau6 gik6 daai6 wat1 juk6
